title: ipomoea pilosula
intro: Ipomoea pilosula, commonly known as the hairy morning glory, is a perennial plant species in the Convolvulaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory function. The health benefits of Ipomoea pilosula include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions of soothing respiratory issues and alleviating pain. The bioactive constituents of Ipomoea pilosula include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
